banner.title: We value your privacy
banner.description: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized ads or content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking "Accept All", you consent to our use of cookies.

modal.title: Privacy Preference Center
modal.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to.

categories.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
categories.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences.

cookies.name: cookie_consent
cookies.purpose: Stores your consent decision so this banner isn't shown again on future visits. Kept in your browser's local storage until you clear your browser data.

cookies.name: cookie_preferences
cookies.purpose: Stores which cookie categories you've allowed. Kept in your browser's local storage until you clear your browser data.

categories.title: Analytics Cookies
categories.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site.

cookies.name: _ga
cookies.purpose: Distinguishes unique visitors for site-traffic reporting. Expires after 2 years.

cookies.name: _gid
cookies.purpose: Distinguishes unique visitors within a 24-hour window. Expires after 24 hours.

categories.title: Marketing Cookies
categories.description: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites.

cookies.name: _fbp
cookies.purpose: Used by Meta to deliver, measure, and improve the relevance of ads. Expires after 90 days.
